title: BMS Point Health (synthetic)
description: Staleness, completeness and comms quality per point. Synthetic data.

panels.title: Points not healthy
panels.description: The triage list: any point below full coverage, or carrying suspect-quality values. Sorted worst first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT point_id, building, point_class, samples_24h, completeness_pct, last_seen, good_pct
  FROM bms.v_point_health
 WHERE completeness_pct < 100 OR good_pct < 100
 ORDER BY completeness_pct ASC
 LIMIT 100

panels.title: Completeness by building and point class
panels.description: A whole point class flat at zero for one building is a controller or network segment that has stopped reporting, not a data quality blip.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS time, building || ' / ' || point_class AS metric, completeness_pct AS value
  FROM bms.v_completeness
 ORDER BY building, point_class

panels.title: Longest gaps in the last day
panels.description: Staleness is the first thing to check when a dashboard looks suspiciously flat.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT point_id, max_gap_minutes
  FROM bms.v_point_health
 WHERE max_gap_minutes IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY max_gap_minutes DESC
 LIMIT 20

panels.title: Suspect quality share
panels.description: Suspect values are accepted, not dropped: the pipeline records them so an operator can decide. A rising share means the plant is reporting trouble, not that the pipeline is broken.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket AS time, point_id AS metric,
       100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE quality = 'suspect') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS value
  FROM bms.readings
 WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
 GROUP BY bucket, point_id
 ORDER BY bucket
